# `aitbc explorer transaction`

Get a transaction summary by its hash.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer transaction [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--tx-hash` | text | — | yes | The Tx hash. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer transaction --tx-hash <tx_hash>
```
